contact_work_definition.oriented_gap: For slave p and master vertices a,b,c, e1=b-a, e2=c-a, m=e1 cross e2 and H=m dot (p-a). The physical signed gap is H/|m|. H has units mm^3, not mm. Reject a degenerate face and a closest projection outside the closed triangle; do not clamp it into a different contact.
contact_work_definition.projection: Use exact scalar Gram quotients for the orthogonal projection and its barycentric coordinates. No inverse matrix, factorization or equilibrium calculation is used.
contact_work_definition.scope: This supplies a one-pair algebraic identity with exact controls, not a 3D contact-search, edge/edge handling, a mesh or continuum nonpenetration certificate. No current candidate multiplier or pressure is computed.
contact_work_definition.units: lambda for this scaled constraint has units N/mm^2 but is not a physical surface pressure density. The slave resultant is lambda*m and its magnitude is lambda*|m|. Pressure requires an explicit quadrature/tributary-area map.
contact_work_definition.work: For the oriented constraint H>=0 use a scaled lambda>=0 with lambda*H=0. Pair forces are +lambda*DH on slave and master positions. At H=0 they are a normal slave resultant and opposite barycentric master resultants from the same multiplier. Off-contact gap derivatives retain the changing-normal terms; do not freeze the master normal.
